baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'akhadhna minhu bi-l-yamin' joins taking/capture to an instrument or side named by yamin.
baseline_models.mechanism: Capture becomes a controlled bodily operation: the right hand or right side supplies the grip, while the taking-root supplies possession, captivity, and immobilization.

activation_trace.role: Literal capture turns the otherwise generic taking into seizure of a person.
A restraining grapple supplies the bodily mechanics of the seizure.
The literal right hand or side locates the controlling hold.

changed_reading.before: We would take something from him by the right.
changed_reading.after: We would seize and immobilize him through a right-hand or right-side hold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same taking-root can mark being taken to account, while yamin can denote power, restraint, and the side of right.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can stage juridical capture rather than anatomy alone: a subject is held answerable by power whose force is presented as rightful, preventive, and decisive.

activation_trace.role: Taking someone for a fault supplies accountability as the action's legal function.
Power joined to right and prevention supplies the warrant and irresistible agency.

changed_reading.before: A strong hand physically grabs him.
changed_reading.after: Rightful authority takes him to account and places him beyond resistance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yamin can name an oath as well as a hand, allowing bi-l-yamin to carry a covenantal instrument alongside the bodily one.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath functions as a bond: what has been pledged supplies the ground on which the speaker can be seized and held answerable.

activation_trace.role: Accountability gives the oath a consequence rather than leaving it as speech alone.
The sworn pledge supplies a non-anatomical instrument that can bind the subject.

changed_reading.before: The right hand is merely the limb used to seize.
changed_reading.after: The seizure can also be execution of liability carried by a sworn bond.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Taking can mean receiving or acquiring, and yamin can carry blessing and good fortune before context fixes the event's direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Read in isolation, the action need not yet be punitive: it can momentarily suggest taking something from or appropriating something associated with him under an auspicious agency.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself opens a non-punitive direction for the taking.
Auspiciousness colors that acquisition as favorable before the surrounding sequence intervenes.

changed_reading.before: Every emphatic taking here must already be coercive.
changed_reading.after: Focus-only branch space briefly permits a favorable reception or appropriation from him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier oath makes the focus yamin resonate as sworn liability: the discourse is placed under oath, and the later taking enforces accountability for violating that speech bond.

activation_trace.role: Taking for a fault supplies the enforcement action.
The oath sense makes yamin a binding speech instrument alongside the hand.
An oath apportioned upon its parties establishes the discourse-wide bond that the focus seizure can enforce.

structural_cues: The oath opens the speech-provenance unit before the conditional seizure appears.
The emphatic conditional at 69:45 sounds like a stipulated consequence within that frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening oath and the focus oath-branch; I infer that the former activates the latter and that seizure enforces the bond. The live alternative is that the oath only emphasizes the discourse while yamin remains bodily power.

changed_reading.before: Oath was a focus-only lexical possibility with no external support.
changed_reading.after: The opening oath turns the seizure into a plausible covenantal enforcement scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sent and delivered utterance has a provenance chain; inventing and attributing even a portion of it breaches that chain. The focus seizure is therefore a custody sanction at the messenger interface, not punishment for undifferentiated speech.

activation_trace.role: Fault-based taking makes the seizure answer a specific provenance breach.
Rightful force supplies authority to police the transmission boundary.
Inventing or falsely attributing speech identifies the precise custody violation.
Messenger and message establish an authorized transmission role rather than free authorship.
Delivery from elsewhere gives the utterance an upstream source that must remain intact.
Partitive segmentation makes even a fragmentary interpolation sufficient to trigger the sanction.

structural_cues: 69:40 identifies an authorized carrier, 69:43 identifies upstream delivery, and 69:44 poses counterfeit insertion.
The focus consequence follows immediately after the hypothetical provenance breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, delivery, fabricated attribution, and a part; I add the chain-of-custody model and the arrow breach-to-seizure. A live alternative is a simpler moral prohibition against lying without a transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Rightful power punishes an unspecified fault.
changed_reading.after: Rightful power arrests the authorized carrier exactly where a delivered message could be adulterated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fabricated attribution followed by severing the life artery reverses the focus-only favorable direction. Blessing no longer plausibly governs the event; at most it survives as a charged inversion in which the auspicious or right side becomes the route of fatal sanction.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition preserves the initially non-punitive baseline that context now tests.
Auspiciousness supplies the positive polarity that the following sequence overturns.
False invention supplies culpability and removes a benign motive for taking.
Actual severance fixes the consequence as destructive rather than receptive.
The life-bearing artery makes the destructive endpoint mortal.

structural_cues: The focus lies between hypothetical fabrication and the sequential marker leading to arterial severance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies culpable invention and a mortal follow-up; I infer that these reverse the positive polarity of yamin. The live alternative is that auspiciousness is inactive here rather than intentionally inverted.

changed_reading.before: The taking might be favorable reception or appropriation.
changed_reading.after: That reading is sharply weakened; its only live residue is an ironic conversion of the auspicious side into a death-bearing one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus seizure becomes stage one of a bodily procedure: a right-hand grapple immobilizes and presents the body, then the life artery is severed. The hand is a tactical control point rather than a generic emblem of strength.

activation_trace.role: The grappling hold supplies immobilization before the next action.
A handle or grip supplies the control interface by which the body is held.
The literal right hand or side locates that control interface.
Severance supplies the second operation performed after restraint.
The vital artery identifies the exact life-bearing target of the second operation.

structural_cues: The sequential particle at 69:46 orders cutting after taking.
The repeated first-person plural verbs make the two acts parts of one controlled sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grapple, a right hand, severance, and a life artery; I add the operational arrow immobilize-then-cut. The materially live alternative is that the two verbs are escalating consequences without a tactical dependency.

changed_reading.before: The hand is a conventional image for force.
changed_reading.after: The right-hand hold is the first concrete step that makes the following arterial cut possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The force of yamin is defined relationally: seizure monopolizes control because no member of the addressed group can insert a separating barrier. Rightful force is thus jurisdiction without an available rescuer or stay.

activation_trace.role: Capture places the subject under another agent's control.
Power that restrains and prevents supplies the jurisdictional force of the capture.
Exhaustive negation removes every possible individual exception or rescuer.
Interposition by a separating barrier names exactly what no one can supply.

structural_cues: The audience is introduced only after taking and cutting, as agents unable to interrupt either action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive non-interposition; I infer that this retroactively specifies yamin-power as exclusive jurisdiction. The alternative is that 69:47 only comments on rescue after the fact and does not shade the focus instrument.

changed_reading.before: Yamin denotes an abstract magnitude of power.
changed_reading.after: Its power consists in control against which no third party can place a barrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual seizure is not only retributive imagery; once the discourse is named a reminder for those who place themselves in protection, the threat functions prospectively as a warning that enables avoidance of the breach.

activation_trace.role: Accountability gives the warning a determinate consequence to remember.
Preventive power makes the threatened consequence credible enough to deter.
A reminder converts the narrated consequence into retained guidance for later conduct.
Protective avoidance supplies the behavioral effect that remembering the threat can produce.

structural_cues: Immediately after denying any rescue, the discourse pivots from consequence to reminder and self-protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder and protection after the threat; I add the causal arrow remembered consequence-to-avoidance. The alternative is that 69:48 characterizes the whole revelation without making this specific threat prophylactic.

changed_reading.before: 69:45 only imagines retrospective punishment after a violation.
changed_reading.after: Its imagined seizure also operates forward as a protective deterrent against corrupting entrusted speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two opposite attribution failures surround the focus: the carrier could falsely ascribe invented speech upstream, while hearers falsely ascribe the delivered speech to lying. Divine knowledge exposes both, and the focus seizure marks the accountability checkpoint on the carrier side of that mirror.

activation_trace.role: Fault-based taking supplies the accountability applied to one side of the attribution mirror.
Rightful force adjudicates competing claims about who authored or falsified the speech.
False invention or attribution defines the hypothetical carrier-side error.
Disclosure to the knower prevents either attributional reversal from remaining hidden.
Charging a thing or speaker with falsehood supplies the audience-side mirror error.

structural_cues: The carrier's hypothetical false attribution precedes the focus, while the audience's actual denial follows it.
The first-person divine agent of seizure is also the knower who identifies deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two reversed false-attribution patterns and divine knowing; I infer a mirrored provenance test with 69:45 as its carrier-side checkpoint. The alternative is that fabrication and denial are separate offenses connected only by topic.

changed_reading.before: The focus singles out one speaker for an isolated act of lying.
changed_reading.after: It occupies one side of a two-way provenance test: neither an envoy nor an audience may reverse the message's true attribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of fixed truth, established due, and certainty sharpens yamin as rightful rather than merely stronger force. Seizure is truth enforcing its valid claim over the speech channel.

activation_trace.role: Taking to account supplies enforcement of a claim rather than unstructured violence.
The side of right joins power to warrant and makes truth-bearing force possible.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the objective standard behind the sanction.
A binding due supplies the juridical claim that accountability enforces.
Settled knowledge removes doubt about the truth that authorizes the taking.

structural_cues: The truth-and-certainty formula closes the same unit that tested fabricated attribution.
Its closure retroactively distinguishes warranted right from raw strength in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a yamin branch joining power with right and a closing truth-certainty pair; I infer semantic reinforcement across the unit. The alternative is that the closing formula validates the revelation generally without selecting the right/truth shade of yamin.

changed_reading.before: The stronger side compels because it can.
changed_reading.after: The right side compels as the enforcement arm of a truth presented as fixed, due, and certain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concluding command to exonerate the sovereign's great name makes the focus sanction protective of attributional integrity. Seizing the carrier is not only about his body; it prevents fabricated speech from attaching to the named authority.

activation_trace.role: Accountability supplies the sanction for attaching unauthorized speech to another.
Rightful preventive force guards the attributional boundary.
Sovereignty identifies the authority whose speech cannot be counterfeited.
Exoneration makes removal of false attribution the unit's final response.
The name as public indication supplies the attributional surface being protected.
Inviolable honor raises false attachment to the name from error to actionable breach.

structural_cues: The unit moves from disputed speech provenance to a final imperative centered on the sovereign name.
The imperative follows truth-certainty, so exoneration is the response to the tested attribution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution earlier and exoneration of the sovereign's great name at closure; I infer that 69:45 protects name-integrity by sanctioning the carrier. The alternative is that the closing praise is devotional closure without a backward causal link.

changed_reading.before: The seizure protects obedience to authority in general.
changed_reading.after: It specifically guards the sovereign name from having counterfeit utterance fastened to it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare death/posture branch of yamin rather than the ordinary hand or power branches. It remains anchored in the focus right-side noun and gains material support from the following life-artery severance. Downstream prose should present it only as a proleptic spatial echo, not as the settled lexical meaning of bi-l-yamin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus explicitly places taking in relation to yamin, whose inventory includes dying through being laid on the right side.

activation_trace.role: A bodily grapple supplies the motion by which the subject could be turned or laid.
Death associated with being laid on the right side turns direction into terminal orientation.
Severance makes the hinted terminal orientation an actual mortal sequence.
The life artery fixes death, rather than mere directional movement, as the endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The right side is only the instrument of seizure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the seizure already turns the body toward the death posture completed by the next verse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant s-m-m mapping beneath the source root s-m-w and links a name to poison entering a body. It remains anchored through the focus branch of a condition taking hold bodily and through the adjacent life artery. It must be rendered as a contained material analogy for corrupt attribution, never as a claim that the source word for name lexically means poison here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus taking-root can depict a condition taking hold in the body, while the surrounding event concerns falsely attached speech and bodily seizure.

activation_trace.role: A condition that seizes the body supplies the focus anchor for invasive contamination.
Invented attribution identifies the semantic contaminant entering the protected channel.
The life artery gives the invasive analogy a bodily conduit and mortal stakes.
The non-dominant poison-entering-body image models false speech as contamination of the name.

changed_reading.before: The body is punished after an external verbal offense.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, counterfeit attribution behaves like an invasive poison that takes the carrier and threatens the message-name conduit from within.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it carries a water-holding branch of the taking-root into speech transmission and reads minhu materially as extraction from a vessel. It remains focus-anchored in 'taking from him' and is supported by delivery, transmission, and the later vital conduit. Downstream prose should label it a reservoir/channel analogy, not replace the ordinary personal-seizure syntax with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The phrase takes 'from him,' and the focus taking-root includes a hollow that gathers and retains a fluid.

activation_trace.role: A retaining basin turns the carrier into a provisional container from which something may be taken.
Rightful control makes extraction from the entrusted container an act of reclaiming custody.
Successive transmission supplies flow through the human carrier rather than authorship originating there.
Delivery fills the carrier from an upstream source.
Invented addition marks contamination of what the carrier holds and passes onward.
The vital conduit materializes the cost of corrupting a channel carried through a body.

changed_reading.before: The subject is only the person grabbed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he is also an entrusted reservoir/channel: rightful seizure reclaims control when the delivered contents are adulterated.

strongest_changes: The speech sequence turns generic accountability into a chain-of-custody sanction for adulterating a delivered message.
The following severance and life artery turn a conventional hand image into a staged grip-then-cut operation.
The no-interposer clause defines yamin-power as exclusive jurisdiction, while truth and certainty distinguish rightful force from raw strength.
The reminder/protection pair lets the counterfactual punishment work prospectively as deterrence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus keeps several instruments live at once: literal right-hand capture, rightful jurisdiction, oath-bound liability, and a weakened auspicious branch. Context does not collapse them into one gloss; it redistributes their confidence and generates bodily, legal, communicative, and protective mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of minhu and bi-l-yamin remains open between personal seizure, extraction, instrument, and side.
The oath and truth resonances may be deliberate activations of yamin or only contextually attractive branch echoes.
The grip-then-cut dependency is reader-supplied; the text may present escalation without procedural necessity.
The death-posture, reservoir, and non-dominant poison mappings are analogical outliers and should not be promoted to default lexical senses.
